slides.title: Claims Portal Rebuild: 40% Faster Payouts
slides.subtitle: Regional insurer | Digital Engineering practice | PM: Jordan Lee | Jan 2026 to Dec 2027

cards.title: Customer Problem
bullets: Claims took 20 days to pay out
Agents re-keyed data across 3 legacy systems
No live view of claim status for customers

cards.title: Scope
bullets: In: claims intake, triage and payout flow
In: migrate 5 years of claims history
Out: policy admin and billing

cards.title: How We Found the Need
bullets: Account review flagged rising complaints
2-week discovery with 14 user interviews
Business case approved by client CFO

cards.title: Deal of Delivery
bullets: Created Feb 2026, at contract signing
Commits 6 releases and 4 payment milestones
Agreed with client VP Claims, on SharePoint

cards.title: Outcomes
bullets: Payout time down from 20 to 12 days (40%)
Manual re-keying removed
CSAT up from 3.6 to 4.3 out of 5
